QuestInfo.name: Tristan's Keepsake
QuestInfo.0: Obtain Tristan's Keepsake from Mu Young.
QuestInfo.1: Mu Young tells you to get Tristan's Keepsake from the Storage Room yourself. Look for the Keepsake in the Storage Room.\r\n\r\n#rTip: You cannot complete the quest without finding the Keepsake from the Storage room. If something goes wrong, abandon the quest and try again.
QuestInfo.2: You were attacked by an unknown enemy! You got Tristan's Keepsake, but what's going on? Is there REALLY a mysterious enemy, like Tristan said?

1.0: Oh, brother. The Storage Room got raided? Did someone really think I'd leave valuables in there? All the good stuff was looted years ago!

yes.0: Anyway, here, take this, my master's diary, or list of records. Whatever you want to call it.

item.0: You still haven't gone in to the Storage Room?
